# Environment model credits

Poly Haven makes these models available for modification and redistribution under Creative Commons CC0 1.0. [Poly Haven asset license](https://polyhaven.com/license) · [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)

- `compressor.glb` is Brian Speight’s Old Military Compressor. [Source model](https://polyhaven.com/a/old_military_compressor)
- `fire-alarm.glb` is Slinc’s Fire Alarm. [Source model](https://polyhaven.com/a/fire_alarm)
- `records-desk.glb` is Ulan Cabanilla’s Metal Office Desk. [Source model](https://polyhaven.com/a/metal_office_desk)
- `dispatch-radio.glb` is Mateusz Sadek’s Vintage Radio Transceiver. [Source model](https://polyhaven.com/a/vintage_radio_transceiver)
- `records-lamp.glb` is Desk Lamp Arm 01 by Kuutti Siitonen and Yann Kervran. [Source model](https://polyhaven.com/a/desk_lamp_arm_01)
- `roof-condenser.glb` is the weathered variant of Monsta3D’s Exterior Aircon Unit. [Source model](https://polyhaven.com/a/exterior_aircon_unit)

The earlier imports bundle resized PBR textures, and simplify the compressor, radio and lamp meshes for browser performance. The following RC25 imports retain their published mesh and 1K PBR maps:

- `roof-strike-wrench.glb`: Will Evarts, [Pipe Wrench](https://polyhaven.com/a/pipe_wrench).
- `boiler-tool-chest.glb`: John Hutcheson (modeling and texturing), Yann Kervran (rigging), [Metal Tool Chest](https://polyhaven.com/a/metal_tool_chest). The imported chest, lid, hinges, locks and handles are separate meshes; the game displays the original open pose.
- `archive-drawer-cabinet.glb`: Ulan Cabanilla, [Drawer Cabinet](https://polyhaven.com/a/drawer_cabinet). The four drawers retain separate meshes.
- `annex-steel-rack.glb`: Luca B, [Worn Metal Rack](https://polyhaven.com/a/worn_metal_rack), instanced and fit to the original visual rack envelope without changing the course.

RC26 also retains the original models and 1K PBR maps from Poly Haven for these repeated dressing families:

- `boiler-cylinder.glb`: Slinc, [Propane Tank](https://polyhaven.com/a/propane_tank).
- `boiler-maintenance-box.glb`: Mateusz Sadek, [Metal Toolbox](https://polyhaven.com/a/metal_toolbox).
- `archive-notepads.glb`: Ulan Cabanilla, [Office Notepads](https://polyhaven.com/a/office_notepads).
- `annex-shipping-crate.glb`: James Ray Cock, [Wooden Crate 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/wooden_crate_01).

RC36 retained Poly Haven's source geometry and 1K PBR maps (CC0 1.0) for five new assets; `art/blender/polyhaven-rc36.blend` collects the editable mesh components and packed maps:

- [Portable Generator](https://polyhaven.com/a/portable_generator) and [Utility Box 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/utility_box_01) by James Ray Cock.
- [Garden Hose Wall Mounted 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/garden_hose_wall_mounted_01) by Kuutti Siitonen.
- [Metal Trash Can](https://polyhaven.com/a/metal_trash_can) by GurJas Studios (rusted display variant only).
- [Korean Fire Extinguisher 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/korean_fire_extinguisher_01) by UM JOORIN.

RC35 roof straight fascia splice and soffit fasteners are original LAST LIGHT geometry. Editable source: `art/blender/roof-splices-rc35.blend`; builder: `art/blender/build_roof_splices_rc35.py`.

RC35 city-grade, crossing, sidewalk, streetlight, low-rise, park, service yard and tower foundation meshes are original LAST LIGHT geometry. Editable source: `art/blender/city-ground-rc35.blend`; builder: `art/blender/build_city_ground_rc35.py`.

RC34 folded roof fascia corners and scarfed soffit returns are original LAST LIGHT geometry. Editable source: `art/blender/roof-corners-rc34.blend`; builder: `art/blender/build_roof_corners_rc34.py`.

RC33 archive folded wall sign tray is original LAST LIGHT geometry. Editable source: `art/blender/sign-mount-rc33.blend`; builder: `art/blender/build_sign_mount_rc33.py`.

RC32 roof deck inside return, annex bound carpet edges and recess thresholds are original LAST LIGHT geometry. Editable source: `art/blender/fit-rc32.blend`; builder: `art/blender/build_fit_rc32.py`.

RC31 interior switch and socket plates, light/suspension assemblies, roof service covers and soffits, and annex corner and seam fittings are original LAST LIGHT geometry. Source: `art/blender/detail-rc31.blend`; builder: `art/blender/build_detail_rc31.py`.

The RC30 pipe corners, ceiling feeds, weatherproof roof fixtures, annex floor hardware and three distant building models are original LAST LIGHT geometry. Their editable source is `art/blender/utilities-rc30.blend`, generated by `art/blender/build_utilities_rc30.py`.

The RC29 junctions, roof coping and soffits, lift landing aprons and annex exit casing are original LAST LIGHT geometry. The editable profiles, seams and hardware are in `art/blender/junctions-rc29.blend`, built by `art/blender/build_junctions_rc29.py`.

The RC28 heat outlets, cold returns, evidence stands and six individual records are original LAST LIGHT geometry. Open `art/blender/inspection-rc28.blend` for editable sheets, labels and fittings, or rebuild using `art/blender/build_inspection_rc28.py`.

The RC27 louvre, pipe saddle and union, archive sash and door, roof edge and annex shaft lining are original LAST LIGHT geometry. Open `art/blender/architecture-rc27.blend` or rebuild it with `art/blender/build_architecture_rc27.py`.

The boiler arrival wall extractor is an original LAST LIGHT model with a stationary guard and a separately driven impeller. Open `art/blender/boiler-arrival-extractor.blend` for the individual parts, or rebuild it with Blender 4.5 and `art/blender/build_boiler_extractor.py`.

The folding steel service lift is an original LAST LIGHT model. Rebuild its landing, inspection gates, cab and deadbolts using Blender 4.5 and `art/blender/build_service_lift.py`.

The pressure gauge, punch clock and rooftop flow meter are original Blender models. Rebuild the three moving instruments with `art/blender/build_workstation_models.py`.

The Records Annex and its fixtures are original LAST LIGHT assets, authored in Blender 4.5. Open the twenty-three assemblies in `art/blender/backrooms-annex.blend` or rebuild them with `art/blender/build_backrooms.py`. The annex uses one instanced kit, including the cast-concrete slabs, tiled return-air gallery, bolt-joined portal beam, rotating extractor and amber stairwell fixtures. The boiler steam trap, outgoing ticket case and roof rainwater hopper each have a separate GLB. The classic edition uses orthographic Cycles views of these models. Wallpaper, carpet, ceiling finish and cast concrete each have original colour, roughness and normal maps.


The archive phonograph is an original LAST LIGHT prop. The spun brass bell, shellac grooves and desk notice are modeled in `art/blender/office-phonograph.blend`.

The archive kit is an original LAST LIGHT scene, authored in Blender 4.5. It includes a chamfered floor slab, two recessed fluorescent fittings, a red fire bulkhead, a steel register cabinet, a return grille, a cast floor drain and curled ledger sheets. Open `art/blender/archive-interior.blend` or rebuild it with `art/blender/build_archive_interior.py`. In the game, the kit instances share source geometry. Its ceramic and plaster scans are credited in the surfaces directory.

## RC21 pressure and roof sets

`boiler-plant.glb` and `roof-plant.glb` contain original Blender geometry, including the B2 gauge bank, pipe return, caged lamps, pressure gantry and sump grates, plus the RAIN 03 tanks, zinc glazing, guarded intake and its impeller, rain scuppers and raised beds. Placement and contact areas were authored against the current game tiles. Each assembly's static parts share one material, with a second emissive primitive for cages that have powered lenses.

The painted-metal atlas incorporates [Metal Plate 02 by Amal Kumar, Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com/a/metal_plate_02) under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Its diffuse, GL normal and ARM maps were recolored, resampled and packed with individual wear levels for each finish. The GLBs include the resulting atlas.

The editable source is `art/blender/pressure-and-roof.blend`. The builder takes the three 1K JPEG maps from Poly Haven in a local directory.

```sh
blender -b --python-exit-code 1 -P art/blender/build_plant_sets.py -- /path/to/metal-plate-maps
```
